subject: Headcount scenario wargame for Q4 QBR — rapid modeling request
thread_body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@hyperioncap.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@onecolab.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount scenario wargame for Q4 QBR — rapid modeling request

Hi team,

As part of QBR prep I want to run a quick set of headcount scenarios (3x: conservative / baseline / aggressive) to understand OKR coverage risk and potential runway impact. Can we do a 48-hour "wargame" where we:

- Baseline: freeze all non-critical backfills, evaluate immediate impact to servicing & sales SLAs
- Aggressive: approve 8 hires across Serving Runtime, Sales AE, and SRE for capacity growth
- Conservative: pause all reqs except mission-critical production roles

I've dropped an initial spreadsheet attached (headcount_scenarios_v1.xlsx) and the current org snapshot (org_snapshot_oct2026.pdf). Marina/Devon, if FinanceOps can provide a 12-month P&L delta and per-FTE fully-burdened costs for each band, that will speed things up.

Action asks:
1) Laura — lead the coverage/risk delta for Product & DX within 24h
2) Vivek — quantify Serving Runtime impact (latency/capacity) and suggest minimal staffing to protect SLAs
3) Hannah — prioritize which reqs you recommend for immediate freeze vs expedite (we trust your triage)
4) FinanceOps (Marina) — provide the cost model stub by EOD tomorrow

We'll convene a 30-minute readout on Wed at 10:00 PT if the data is available. If not, I'll push to Thu morning.

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@hyperioncap.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount scenario wargame for Q4 QBR — rapid modeling request

Avery — thanks for kicking this off. I can run the product/DX coverage delta and map the reqs to OKRs. Quick notes:
- I already flagged three senior PM backfills as high impact to Q4 launches (PM-341, PM-356, PM-361)
- I will publish a short "impact matrix" (link to Drive in related_links) by tomorrow noon.

On the convene time — Wed 10:00 PT works for me but I can be flexible if FinanceOps needs more time.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@hyperioncap.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount scenario wargame for Q4 QBR — rapid modeling request

Avery — I will run a throughput/latency sensitivity across three staffing levels for Serving Runtime. Initial plan:
- Run a quick sim using current load curves and cache hit assumptions (will use staging traces)
- Identify minimal slot counts to meet 99th pct latency SLO under baseline and conservative
- Highlight risk areas (quantization rollout, model warm-up costs)

I'll need the org snapshot and the spreadsheet (got both). Expect a short write-up and a table by EOD Tue.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure & Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@hyperioncap.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@onecolab.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount scenario wargame for Q4 QBR — rapid modeling request

Thanks Avery — we can get the cost stub ready. Quick Qs:
1) Do you want fully-burdened cost per FTE by band or by functional role? We can provide both but it changes the turnaround.
2) Any assumptions re: ramp time (I assume 3 months for senior hires, 6–9 weeks for ICs)?

We will aim for a simplified delta model (monthly cash impact + 12-month P&L) by EOD Wed if you confirm the assumptions.

—Marina
FinanceOps, Hyperion Capital (finance partner)
marina.lopez@hyperioncap.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@hyperioncap.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount scenario wargame for Q4 QBR — rapid modeling request

Quick update from triage: I recommend the following immediate actions to enable a clean QBR narrative and avoid slippage:

1) Approve 2 serving runtime hires (senior infra engineer + runtime performance engineer) — these are critical to preserving the Serving SLAs tied to customer renewals.
2) Expedite 1 AE hire for the largest expansion deal (RidgeCloud) — cost-neutral if we keep 1 global SDR vacancy open for 2 months.
3) Freeze 4 generic backfills (apply to internals, non-customer-facing ICs) — minimal OKR impact but frees short-term dollars.

I've updated the attached spreadsheet with a tab called "Hannah_Triage_recs" and left comments on PM backfills. Will be ready for the readout slot on Thu 10:00 PT (pushed one day to accommodate finance).

Hannah Schmitt
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
